children: UPDATES ITS FORECAST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026

AGAINST BACKDROP OF AN IMPAIRMENT OF PORSCHE AG GOODWILL, A CHALLENGING MARKET ENVIRONMENT, ESPECIALLY IN CHINA, AND ADDITIONAL RESTRUCTURING EXPENSES, VOLKSWAGEN AG IS UPDATING ITS FORECAST FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
OUTLOOK 2026: COMPANY NOW EXPECTS GROUP SALES REVENUE OF AROUND 315 BILLION EUROS
VOLKSWAGEN AG-OUTLOOK 2026:  COMPANY NOW EXPECTS TO ACHIEVE AN OPERATING RETURN ON SALES OF UP TO 1 PERCENT
OUTLOOK 2026: CONTINUES TO EXPECT NET CASH FLOW IN AUTOMOTIVE DIVISION TO BE IN RANGE OF EUR 3 BILLION TO EUR 6 BILLION

DEVELOPMENT OF OPERATING EARNINGS WILL BE IMPACTED BY A FURTHER DETERIORATION IN MARKET ENVIRONMENT, ESPECIALLY IN CHINA, AS WELL AS AN ACCELERATED SHIFT IN DEMAND IN FAVOR OF BATTERY-ELECTRIC VEHICLES

VOLKSWAGEN AG EXPECTS ADDITIONAL RESTRUCTURING EXPENSES FROM EXPANSION OF EARLY RETIREMENT SCHEMES AND PLANNED SALE OF VOLKSWAGEN OSNABRÜCK GMBH IN CONNECTION WITH "FUTURE OF VOLKSWAGEN" AGREEMENT REACHED AT END OF 2024
GROUP BOARD OF MANAGEMENT AND SUPERVISORY BOARD WILL DECIDE ON PROPOSAL OF DIVIDEND FOR 2026 FINANCIAL YEAR TO BE PAID OUT IN JUNE 2027 TO ANNUAL GENERAL MEETING AT BEGINNING OF 2027
FORECAST IS BASED ON ASSUMPTION THAT CURRENT TARIFF SITUATION IN INTERNATIONAL TRADE WILL PERSIST
